chapter: The district underworld and street musicians
title: Drugs in the district: pills, needles and opium pipes
summary: Allen asks about pill rolling and cocaine; Dawson says dope was everywhere, with needles and opium pipes in the houses.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, did they roll pills around there? I guess so, they did everything.
There was one guy, John Lollop. Everything, you know.
John, I think it was John Lollop told me about one guy that rolled so many pills that turned him white. Yeah, well. Yeah, well.
He killed them too. Yeah. That dopewood racket was hard and there nobody, everybody was using that stuff mostly. What about crown?
Did you ever hear of crown? No.
I know, all I knew was the needle that set up with the head, you know. They shot up with the needle? Yeah. They used to shoot the stuff up and they'd blow the pipe, you know. Yeah.
They had a pipe you had. For opium?
Opium pipe, yeah. That was a big hit down there. And all them houses had, you know. Uh-huh. And people would get back up and then smoke them pipes and they'd hide.
Ah. You can't tell what's going on in the house.
Yeah. You know. What's that drive?
People would get back up and then smoke them pipes and they'd hide. Where?
